name: input-group
description: A source-owned shadcn-style InputGroup for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: InputGroup/InputGroupAddon/InputGroupButton/InputGroupText/InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea replicate upstream's bordered-field-with-addons composition. InputGroupButton reuses the installed Button's own ButtonVariant/ButtonSize enums directly (Ghost/Xs default) instead of a duplicate parallel size scale. InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea author their own flush classes rather than composing Input/Textarea, since adico_lib::cn has no Tailwind-merge equivalent to reliably override those components' fixed classes. InputGroupAddon omits upstream's click-to-focus-sibling-input JavaScript (a non-essential UX nicety); see the module doc comment.
